$comment: Normative package boundary map, enforced by tests/repo/package-boundaries.test.ts. Read docs/adr/D12-package-dependency-map.md before editing: removing a prohibition requires an ADR.

prohibited.reason: The schema package is the persistent data contract and the root of the dependency graph.
Fixtures are pure data. Every package may devDepend on them, so any outgoing edge would create a cycle.
Commands are document transforms. UI and AI share one command bus that must work without a renderer.
Player and Producer share the runtime build. Shared code moves down into renderer-dom or runtime, never sideways.
Player and Producer share the runtime build. Shared code moves down into renderer-dom or runtime, never sideways.
The evaluation stays free of any environment; rendering builds on it, never the reverse (D20).
Both hosts load the renderer as part of the one runtime build, so it cannot know either host (D20).
The host facade sits on top of the bus and the Player; nothing below it may know it, so every edit keeps one path through the bus (D44).
The facade drives the preview through the Player only; it renders and evaluates nothing itself (D44).

playwright-core.reason: The Producer drives the pinned Chromium through Playwright; the exact version pins the browser build (D26.1). Used by @kadrion/producer only.
